name: Scale: Rise of Dragons
storyline:
At the dawn of time, there existed only the Ancient Dragons in their eternal realm

Desiring a realm of their own, four Ancients combined their powers and created the realm of Infinitus.

Genesis - Master of Time
Exodus - Master of Order
Begin - Master of Creation
And
End - Master of Destruction

Each believing themselves to be the true ruler over this new realm, these Ancients began to argue; but knew that if they brought their full power to bear against one another, the realm would be destroyed.

They agreed to allow fate to be decided by a contest among them, where they would create subordinates who would battle on their behalf.

They each shed scales into the universe, giving rise to the Dragons of the realm. Next, they scattered treasures and fragments of their power across the universe.

The Ancients now observe as their followers battle through guile and strength, collecting treasure and power to determine the fate of Infinitus.
summary: SCALE is a highly competitive and FREE fantasy card game that takes all of the best mechanics of popular TCG's and puts them into one action-packed game that gives you ALL of the cards for free. You can react to every move your opponent makes, making for exciting and fast paced competition!
